about: Researched postcodes for company 1 venue master (public.project_venues). Public business locations. Read by scripts/fill-master-postcodes.mjs: used only when a row name matches (case and surrounding spaces ignored), confidence is high or medium, the postcode is in scm.my_localities and its state agrees. City/State are written from my_localities.
